result.description: The query result built by the Orbit service. Its shape is set by the Orbit query response schema and versioned by its `format_version` field. An empty string when the Orbit service returns no result.

query_type.description: The type of query that was run.

raw_query_strings.description: The compiled queries, for debugging. Present only when the Orbit service returns them.

row_count.description: The number of rows in the returned page.
